metadata.title: Karnataka Food Festival KAIRUCHI in Delhi I Bisi Bele Bath + Bangude Fry + Ghee Jeera Rice Biryani
metadata.description:
We recently visited Karnataka Food Festival organised by Delhi Karnataka Sangh after receiving a warm invitation from Shruti Bhajantari, a fellow foodie and home chef. The food fair showcasing the diverse flavors of Karnataka was a rich experience for food enthusiasts like us. At this exciting culinary event we savoured the rich and varied dishes from different regions of Karnataka.

This included the aromatic and spicy North Karnataka delicacies, coconut infused coastal delights, traditional flavors of Mysore and many more things. It was a pleasant surprise for us to enjoy such diverse and delicious food without burning a hole in the pocket. 

For a foodie, this festival was a haven of diverse aromas, tastes and textures that provided an opportunity to appreciate the breadth and depth of Karnataka's culinary heritage. It was celebration of the state's gastronomic diversity, offering an incredible feast that caters to every palate and leaves one craving for more.

Thanks to Shruti for inviting us to this remarkable food event. The experience was truly enchanting.
